// diagnostic

E2511

Operator `{op}` isn't defined between `{lhs}` and `{rhs}`.

What

Operator `{op}` isn't defined between `{lhs}` and `{rhs}`.

Why

Operator overloading is blessed on the closed built-in math family ONLY (D-SIMD2/D-LINALG1): element-wise `+`/`-` (and `/` for lanes), `*` (element-wise, or matrix×vector), and `==`/`!=` — both sides must be the same lane/vector type (or a matrix and its matching vector).

Fix

Match the operand types, or use a named method like `.dot()`/`.cross()`/`.matmul()`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2511: tests/ui/math_operator_mismatch.stderr.

Error [E2511]: `+` isn't defined between `F32x4` and `F64x2`
  --> tests/ui/math_operator_mismatch.jet:5:18
    |
  5 |     bad :: F32x4{v + w}
    |                  ^^^^^
 Why: the built-in math types support element-wise `+`/`-` (and `/` for lanes), `*` (element-wise, or matrix×vector), and `==`
 Fix: check the operands are the same lane/vector type, or use a method like `.dot()`/`.matmul()`
